information_policy: All three folds are previously inspected development folds; no independent confirmation, final2019-2024 reads or model promotion. SCANFI full-series future imagery blocks as-of forecasts. Strict prior-epoch species and previous-year incident-count joins; first lag missing and train-median imputed. Six extra weather columns are already audited ECCC aggregates, not added independent years.
optimization_policy: Three predeclared normalized starts per depth1–4. Choose the lowest observed feasible expected training objective across starts; ties choose earliest start. Keep every evaluation and cap/convergence flag. No validation selection. Physical gamma = normalized gamma / feasible energy range. Uniform Dicke initialization; exact cardinality-sector classical simulation.
resource_policy: Entire run is classical sector simulation, addon diagonal SQD checks and Qiskit analytic FidelityQuantumKernel downstream; no hardware authority inferred from these data. Original fixed scaling/final artifacts unchanged. Hard per-optimizer evaluation limits; wall limit checked between cohorts; no automatic rerun of output.
sampling_policy: For uniform and each training-chosen optimized depth,20 paired MC seeds at256/1024 samples. Same data/seed mapping as historical scaling. Downstream fixed ridge/RBF/QSVR on representative predeclared1024 seed plus exact and MI controls:189 fits, not retuned models. Nested regression tuning is a separate new plan.
sqd_policy: Diagonal QUBO: SQD eigenvalue equals minimum observed cost; it supplies no additional optimization beyond the sampling distribution.
